description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConfigResolver class, specifically testing the parsing of gateway endpoints and setup codes, as well as the resolution of gateway connection configurations.

classes.name: GatewayConfigResolverTest
classes.description: A test suite verifying the behavior of gateway endpoint parsing and connection configuration resolution.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointUsesDefaultTlsPortForBareWssUrls
methods.description: Tests that a bare wss URL defaults to port 443 and uses TLS.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Ensures non-loopback ws URLs without TLS are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsTailnetCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Checks that tailnet (non-loopback) ws URLs are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointOmitsExplicitDefaultTlsPortFromDisplayUrl
methods.description: Verifies that explicitly default TLS port (443) is omitted from display URL.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that localhost ws URLs are accepted with correct config.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLocalhostCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that localhost URLs with ws protocol are accepted.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsAndroidEmulatorCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Verifies acceptance of Android emulator IP addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsPrivateLanCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests acceptance of private LAN IP addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsMdnsCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Checks acceptance of mDNS hostnames.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Verifies IPv6 loopback addresses are accepted with proper config.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv4MappedIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsCleartextLoopbackPrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures URLs with bypass host prefix are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Checks rejection of non-loopback IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Acceptance test for link-local IPv6 addresses with Zone ID.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
methods.description: Acceptance test for IPv6 URLs with TLS.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv4CleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Rejects unspecified IPv4 addresses (0.0.0.0).

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Rejects unspecified IPv6 addresses (::).

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Accepts loopback URLs with http scheme.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsRawSetupCode
methods.description: Verifies raw setup code string is accepted.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsQrJsonPayload
methods.description: Checks that QR JSON payloads containing setup code are resolved correctly.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Ensures invalid setup code inputs are rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithInvalidSetupCode
methods.description: Checks rejection of JSON with invalid setupCode.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithNonStringSetupCode
methods.description: Verifies rejection of JSON where setupCode is not a string.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextGateway
methods.description: Rejects setup codes pointing to non-loopback insecure URLs.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Ensures setup codes indicating insecure remote URLs are flagged.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Checks that insecure remote URL results are flagged properly.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultAcceptsLanCleartextGateway
methods.description: Accepts LAN IP gateway URLs while providing correct config.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCodeParsesBootstrapToken
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap token can be decoded from setup code.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigPrefersBootstrapTokenFromSetupCode
methods.description: Tests that bootstrap token from setup code is preferred in config resolution.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigDefaultsPortlessWssSetupCodeTo443
methods.description: Ensures port defaults to 443 for portless wss URLs.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualPreservesBootstrapTokenWhenNoReplacementAuthExists
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap token is preserved when manually configuring connection without auth replacement.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenReplacementPasswordExists
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap token is dropped if a password replacement is provided.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenEndpointChanges
methods.description: Checks bootstrap token is reset when the host/endpoint changes.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigAllowsPrivateLanManualCleartextEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies manual configuration permits private LAN addresses.
